name: Progression - Different Course, Provider B Approved
description: SLD POSTs ZSC00001 for the same learner with Provider A. Without Provider A ever being approved, SLD then POSTs a different course (ZSC00002) for Provider B. The employer approves Provider B's record only.

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) Creates a Short Course (ZSC00001)
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Different Short Course (ZSC00002)
Employer Approves Provider B Short Course
